title: Pure Nemesis
summary: Pure Nemesis (Nemeses in the TCG) Type-lock and banish-cycling build led by Archnemeses Eschatos, with Rank 4 Type searchers and Link-1 Type converters. Each small Nemeses monster shuffles a banished monster back into the Deck to Special Summon itself from the hand and search or recur another Nemeses, stocking distinct Monster Types in the GY for Eschatos.

summary.title: Starters
points: Bonfire (Limited) and Infernal Flame Banshee directly search Level 2 FIRE Pyro Nemeses Flag from the Deck.

Gold Sarcophagus (Limited) banishes Nemeses Keystone from the Deck so Nemeses Flag, Corridor, and Umbrella are immediately live on Turn 1, and Keystone adds itself back to the hand during the End Phase.

Normal Summoning Nemeses Keystone or Umbrella and linking into Salamangreat Almiraj triggers Parallel eXceed in the hand to summon two Level 4 Cyberse bodies for Rank 4 Infernal Flame Banshee or Gallant Granite.

summary.title: Opening: Normal Summon + Parallel eXceed
steps: Normal Summon Nemeses Keystone (Rock) and Link Summon Salamangreat Almiraj (Cyberse); trigger Parallel eXceed to Special Summon two Level 4 copies and Xyz Summon Infernal Flame Banshee (Pyro).

Detach from Infernal Flame Banshee to search Nemeses Flag; banish Keystone from the GY (via Dimensional Fissure or a Link play) or use Gold Sarcophagus, then shuffle a banished monster back with Nemeses Flag to Special Summon Flag and search Archnemeses Eschatos or Nemeses Corridor.

Shuffle a banished monster back with Nemeses Corridor (Thunder) to Special Summon Corridor, tribute Corridor to summon Thunder Dragon Colossus, and banish 3 different Types from your GY/field to Special Summon Archnemeses Eschatos.

summary.title: Banish Cycling & Multi-Type Setup
summary.text: Every small Nemeses monster has a different Attribute and Type: Nemeses Flag (FIRE Pyro) searches a Nemeses from the Deck, Nemeses Corridor (WIND Thunder) adds a banished Nemeses to the hand, Nemeses Umbrella (WATER Aqua) recovers a Nemeses from the GY, and Nemeses Keystone (EARTH Rock) returns to the hand in the End Phase when banished. Salamangreat Almiraj (Cyberse), Artemis, the Magistus Moon Maiden (Spellcaster), and Haggard Lizardose (Reptile) add still more Types to the GY so Archnemeses Eschatos always has 3 different Types to banish.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Archnemeses Eschatos (Level 11 LIGHT Dragon, 3000 ATK) Special Summons itself by banishing 3 monsters with different Types from your field and/or GY, cannot be destroyed by card effects, and declares a Monster Type on the field to destroy all monsters of that Type and lock both players out of Special Summoning that Type until the end of the next turn.

Thunder Dragon Colossus, summoned by tributing Thunder-Type Nemeses Corridor after activating its Thunder hand effect, stops the opponent from adding cards from their Deck to their hand except by drawing.
Infernal Flame Banshee revives itself if banished while you control Pyro-Type Nemeses Flag, and Gallant Granite detaches to search Rock-Type Nemeses Keystone.

summary.title: Spells & Left out
points: Nemeses Adrastea is a Quick-Play Spell that Special Summons any Nemeses monster from your GY or banishment.
Dimensional Fissure banishes any monster sent to the GY, keeping banished targets available for Flag, Corridor, and Umbrella while disrupting GY decks.
Left out: Archnemeses Protos is Forbidden on the TCG Banlist.
